response_change.child_relation: Keep the same stage-flow structure but relax the idealized constant clearance hazard so that departure from C depends nonlinearly on contagious burden, making dC_dt bend downward more strongly at higher C even when P is unchanged.
response_change.observable_effect: Across trajectories with similar P but different C, the decline and post-peak decay of C become disproportionately faster at larger C; the parent can only scale this loss linearly with one shared clearance parameter.

diagnostic_groups.name: inflow_pressure
diagnostic_groups.role: Current entry flux from presymptomatic shedding into contagiousness

diagnostic_groups.name: contagious_burden
diagnostic_groups.role: Current occupancy of the contagious compartment governing burden-dependent departure strength

diagnostic_groups.name: net_parent_target
diagnostic_groups.role: Parent scored target mapping for comparison against burden-curved clearance

contract.activation_condition: Observable when contagious occupancy reaches moderate to high levels so that burden-dependent departure is non-negligible relative to baseline linear clearance, while P remains positive or recently declining during the peak and decay window.
contract.train_hidden_contrast: In training, early growth at low C still resembles the parent because clearance is near-linear; in holdout regimes with larger peak C or slower presymptomatic depletion, the stronger high-C downturn and sharper post-peak decay reveal the changed curvature.
contract.continuation_path: Recover the parent in the limit of vanishing burden dependence in contagious departure, where clearance becomes effectively proportional to C over the observed range.
contract.domain_mechanism: burden-accelerated departure from the contagious compartment
contract.scientific_mechanism: At high contagious burden, symptom recognition, self-isolation, clinical removal, or rapid depletion of highly shedding individuals can make effective departure from the counted contagious class accelerate with C rather than remain exactly linear.
contract.difficulty_rationale: This is structurally harder than a coefficient-only correction because the loss law now depends jointly on clearance_rate and the state C, changing the shape of the target mapping across occupancy levels rather than merely rescaling it.
contract.assumption_before: Departure from contagiousness is a time-independent first-order loss term clearance_rate*C with no occupancy dependence.
contract.assumption_after: Departure from contagiousness has a burden-accelerated hazard, with effective loss growing with contagious occupancy.
contract.parent_reduction: Setting contagious_clearance_burden = 0 exactly recovers the parent target equation.
contract.observable_signature: Compared at times or parameter settings where presymptomatic inflow pressure is similar but C differs, the child produces nearly parent-like behavior at low C and increasingly stronger negative dC_dt at higher C, yielding a lower earlier peak and sharper post-peak decay. This is a changed target mapping, not only an auxiliary-trajectory change, because the scored C equation itself gains an explicit quadratic-in-C loss contribution.
contract.shortcut_blocked: A single refit of the parent clearance_rate cannot reproduce both low-C near-linear clearance and high-C accelerated loss across these conditions, because the parent loss term is strictly proportional to C. Retuning existing parent parameters can shift overall timing and scale, but it cannot create the added high-C downward curvature in the scored mapping without over-altering low-C behavior.
